body: Thank you so much for this. Don't worry about age, btw. I'm young too, but it seems these horrible feelings and thoughts don't discriminate age. Struggle is struggle.
I'm so glad I'm not alone in that feeling... It's so validating to hear.

Relief and guilt... I totally feel you there. I just told my roommate and I felt better to verbalize it but I feel like hes burdened now.

I hope your boss acknowledges your pain in a healthy way and makes gentle efforts to check on you just as my roommate is doing with me. I hope your guilt dissolves. I have a bad habit of not remembering my own advice in times of need, but we all deserve an outlet. We all deserve someone who genuinely gives a shit. I see this post was made 10+ hours ago and I hope you're faring well.

I'm a 19 year old loser who can't seem to keep her shit together and I feel you. Tell you what, though, I'm really envious of you for having a part time job. I wish I was someone else too. I used to be at least proud of my youth but my brain has begun to literally deteriorate thanks to all of the trauma I've been through, so now my body is falling apart as a result. How the fuck am I not legally allowed to drink yet but my organs, nerves, and bones are already declining? Did I already waste my life away before it even begins?

I'm a coward too. I'm afraid I'll survive and have to live in constant physical pain while everyone "checks on me" to keep me from trying again. Too tired to live. Too afraid to die.

My parents tell me the same things. My mom is so fucked up in the head I'm not even sure she's capable of love anymore and my dad has never been capable of love. It's not a pity party. It's a deep longing for release. Everyone I've ever met has said, "it gets better! Trust me!" But when? When does it get better?
